visual_argument: All 2,895 likely pairs, gathered at the triangle's own cell scale, are one brass tile among dark tiles of the same size on the plate that holds every pair once.
build_risk: A sub-pixel cell scale on a full-bleed TXBENCH plate, where the tiling grooves must read as tiles rather than a calendar or floor, and one brass tile must read and cast at 432 px without being enlarged.
distinct_from_recent: No. 69 was a dark dock bay at last light with spatial scenes, no. 70 a floodlit rig floor with pipe reliefs, no. 71 a Dallas street at night. This deck is one lab interior and a black machined plate in plan, with brass as its only accent and no vehicle, street, yard or person.
